## Development Environment

For detailed setup and development instructions, please refer to our [Development Guide](../docs/how-to-develop.md).

### User Interaction

In the chat, always respond to the user in Brazilian Portuguese.
Consider the following points when communicating with the team:

- The team does not have a technical background. Explain things simply whenever possible and avoid software jargon.
- Any new code must be easy to maintain and understand, even for those without significant programming experience.

## Program Architecture

- The site's users are students and teachers. Ensure the user experience is simple.
- Do not create additional applications or services.
- Do not create command-line tools.
- Do not create an application consisting of a single, lengthy file. Always use an easy-to-understand directory structure.
- Use only HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python. No other languages.
